## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] If this touches `firestore.rules`, `src/lib`, `src/pages`, Functions or `packages/`: `test:rules` and `test:e2e` pass for every affected app
- [ ] New logic has a test
- [ ] A Firestore field added or removed: this is only one of the two releases (allow it, then use it)
- [ ] Bringing an app in: every item under "Bringing an app in" in AGENTS.md is done

Merging into `main`? Use **Create a merge commit**, never squash.
